description: This Java source file defines the singleton class EntityConfig, which models and loads configuration data from the entityengine.xml file used within the OFBiz framework. It manages resources, transactions, delegators, readers for various entity configurations, field types, and data sources, providing programmatic access to these components within the application.

classes.name: EntityConfig
classes.description: Singleton class that reads and provides access to the entity configuration defined in entityengine.xml for the OFBiz framework.

methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of EntityConfig.
